criterion.status: PROVISIONAL research comparison criterion, not a production safety margin
criterion.rule: Require all 15 confirmation trials to complete with finite results and the paired 95% percentile-bootstrap upper bound for mean DLRS-minus-baseline test NLL to be <=0.05 against each tuned baseline
criterion.interval: Enumerate all 5^5 ordered bootstrap resamples of paired seed differences; pointwise exploratory percentile intervals, not exact frequentist coverage or simultaneous confidence guarantees
criterion.margin_context: 0.05 nats corresponds to exp(0.05), about 1.0513 times perplexity; chosen before outcomes as a provisional bound, not justified by a downstream user risk budget
criterion.failures: Retain failed tuning and confirmation trials; failed tuning candidates cannot be selected; any failed/missing confirmation or budget interruption prevents acceptance
criterion.timing: Record wall times and paired ratios only as exploratory shared-laptop observations
